tbesh_html:
1) to see, behold, observe, regard
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to behold, observe
1a2) to regard
1a3) to watch, watch (stealthily), lie in wait

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of going round for inspection);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: behold, lay wait, look, observe, perceive, regard, see.
